subject: general
question: Panihari folk music is indigenous to which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Women from Rajasthan **created the** Panihari music style**.
 
• Women who fetch water from afar called **Panihari.**
 
• As unacknowledged sacrifices at the altar of everyday domesticity, **women chant Panihari **as an **expression of their love and disappointment.**
 
• A well-known **Panihari ballad** tells the story of a young, **unmarried girl w**ho meets a stranger while returning from the well.
 
• **Maand and Pabuji Ki Phach **are other folk music of Rajasthan. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **State**
 **Folk Music**
 
 

 Gujarat
 Duha, Sorathaa, Chaand, Belaads, etc
 
 

 Uttarakhand
 Dhol damau, Turri, ransingha, dholki, daur, thali, bhankora and mashakbaja
 
 

 Odisha
 Mahari, Gotipua, Prahallada Nataka, Radha Prema Lila, Pala, Dasakathia, Bharata Lila, Khanjani Bhajana
